Definition: Mithkah, a place in the Desert
BiblicalUsage: Mithkah is a station in the wilderness journey, named twice in the record of the march. They removed from Tarah and pitched in Mithkah, and they removed from Mithkah and pitched in Hashmonah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the stations are kept because the journey was kept: every camp is named, and no step of the wilderness is forgotten.
